title: Multilingual welcome screens

location.extent: Complete published video; PNG is one poster frame

slide_intent: Test the same hierarchy across languages because translated words change length and shape.
strategic_value: A recurring illustration and button structure can keep Wise recognizable as the headline changes script and wording.
demonstration: A portrait phone-shaped panel cycles English, Japanese, Portuguese and French copy beneath the same floating money illustration; the two lower buttons remain in place.
practical_value: Compare line breaks and text density across localized versions without changing the main composition.

content_islands.name: Illustration
content_islands.spec: Keep the banknote and coins above the copy.

content_islands.name: Localized hierarchy
content_islands.spec: Change headline and explanatory text inside the same vertical region.

content_islands.name: Actions
content_islands.spec: Retain two pill-shaped entry buttons at the bottom.
